verdict.rationale: Data region and residency choice is a fair question for a hosted analytics SaaS like PostHog, but nothing in the evidence pack documents selectable storage regions or residency controls. The only related item is a community mention of a docker deploy (posthog-comm-6), and self-deployment is a user-side arrangement rather than a documented residency feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
